scope: Read-only fixture-path investigation for EXT-D-0201 and the remaining Notes T02 member move retest

scope_tree.use: Authenticated, stable tree of types and scopes for the explicitly selected organization.

homes.use: Read synthetic General homes as well as materialized homes; match rows to selected organization in memory.

canonical_reads.read_transport: Authenticated RPC POST with Content-Profile and Accept-Profile set to the owning schema and X-Organization-Id set to the selected organization. Do not treat a 404 from a noncanonical table/view REST path as evidence that the type or scope is absent.

evidence.prior_observation: Run 38202446117 authenticated as a non-admin member. platform.my_homes returned one canonical General with null scope_id, while custom.context_tree returned zero selected-org scopes and zero selected-org types. The harness stopped before Notes UI or fixture writes.
evidence.current_state: No current same-org live RPC read was made in this investigation. Whether the selected organization now has a type or materialized home is unmeasured; the prior zero-type result does not establish current state.

fixture_path.when_general_type_exists: Read the selected-org tree and homes, confirm exactly one canonical General with a valid scope_type_id and a matching type in that organization, then create uniquely named, run-owned child scopes under that type through custom.context_scope_write. Pass p_organization_id explicitly. Its arguments and same-org authorization contract are in aidream/db-contract/custom.json:5369-5460; the native helper pattern is tests/browser/notes-find-native-case.mjs:61-108.
fixture_path.when_no_type_exists: Do not run the current home fixture helper: its precondition requires a materialized General and matching type. A separately authorized fixture setup would first create an owned organization type via custom.context_type_write, then owned scopes; its explicit-org contract is in aidream/db-contract/custom.json:5854-5915. This investigation performed no such writes.
fixture_path.note_move_retest: Create the owned test note through the Notes UI, preserve its returned exact note UUID in the private recovery ledger, move it through the Notes home picker to a run-owned explicit home, then verify the displayed home, persistence after reload, and list/search behavior. The source move uses platform.set_home through src/lib/notes/queries.ts:56-80; the canonical door contract is aidream/db-contract/platform.json:19022-19120.

cleanup.required_order: Delete every run-owned note by its exact recorded UUID through the Notes UI and verify it is absent; only after all owned notes are confirmed deleted, archive only the exact run-owned scope UUIDs and verify they are absent from the selected-org tree. Retain the private recovery ledger if any cleanup is pending; never delete or archive by title alone or touch General/pre-existing scopes.
cleanup.ledger: Existing writer uses mode 0600 and stores owned IDs and synthetic fixture titles, not note bodies or auth material.

lazy_general_limit: A note created through the Notes UI initializes General. Moving that note to an owned custom home tests move/persistence and cleanup, but cannot reproduce moving to the still-lazy synthetic General. The lazy-General picker-only subtarget is separately covered by run 38204518274; the original move-to-lazy-General behavior remains unmeasured.

cross_organization_retest_candidate.strategy: With a member account that belongs to two disposable test organizations, create an owned note through the Notes UI while the source organization is active; that materializes only the source General. Confirm the target organization's General remains synthetic with null scope_id through platform.my_homes and has no scope in custom.context_tree. Switch the active organization to the target, open the owned source note from the cross-organization Notes list, then choose the target synthetic General in the editor. Verify that ensure_general_scope materializes the target General only on selection, set_home changes the note's organization and home together, and the result survives reload and appears in the target list/filter/search. Delete the exact run-owned note and verify absence. Use only a disposable target organization because materializing its General is an intentional lasting write, not a run-owned scope that can be archived.
cross_organization_retest_candidate.preconditions: The test member must own the source note and be a current member of both source and target organizations; target General must still be lazy at the time of the move. The selected-org membership and target lazy state have not been checked live in this investigation.
cross_organization_retest_candidate.evidence: At 2026-10-12T06:31Z, a read-only live pg_get_functiondef(platform.set_home) query through the canonical admin-query operator showed cross-organization moves require owner or full access plus membership in both organizations, and update home_scope_id and organization_id in one write. Extension listMyNotes reads the owner-visible list without active-org filtering (src/lib/notes/queries.ts); listHomeChoices includes synthetic General (src/lib/homes/queries.ts); createNote writes the active org without a home (src/lib/notes/queries.ts). No move or fixture write was performed.
cross_organization_retest_candidate.unverified: The account's two-org fixture availability, target lazy state, actual UI move, persistence, surrounding Notes cases, and cleanup are unverified. This is a candidate procedure, not a product pass.
